channel.description: The FOX News Rundown is your daily news podcast for making sense of the big issues directly impacting your life. Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: Malcolm Gladwell Challenges the Narrative on U.S. Violence, Guns & Crime
item.description:
Earlier this week, best-selling author and Revisionist History host Malcolm Gladwell joined host Dave Anthony on the FOX News Rundown to discuss his latest book, The American Way of Killing: The Invention of an Epidemic.
In the wide-ranging interview, Gladwell challenges conventional wisdom on both sides of the political aisle. He breaks down why the U.S. remains under-policed compared to Europe, the complicated history of the Second Amendment, the reality of assault weapon bans versus handguns, and how modern emergency medicine has fundamentally shifted how we measure violence. Plus, Gladwell reflected on a decade of podcasting and why storytelling remains his ultimate passion.
The conversation ran long, so we only ran a portion of it earlier this week on the FOX News Rundown. Today, on the FOX News Rundown: Extra, you will hear it all! Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: Are Democrats Setting Up Their Base for Disappointment?

item.itunes:author: FOX News Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Rising inflation, tariffs, and anti-incumbent backlash are shaking up traditional party strongholds across key Senate and House battlegrounds ahead of the midterm elections. While many believe the cycle favors Democrats this year, questions remain about whether they can deliver on bold campaign promises even if they take control of the House and the Senate. FOX News Senior Congressional Correspondent Chad Pergram joins to break down surprisingly tight contests in states like Kansas, Michigan, and South Carolina and the internal ideological rift awaiting a potential Democratic majority—detailing the clash between progressive demands for cabinet impeachments and the practical constraints faced by moderate swing-district lawmakers.
Plus, Oklahoma Senator James Lankford joins to analyze how soaring diesel costs, domestic refining limits, and conflicts in Ukraine and Iran are affecting consumer prices, while warning that a Democratic Senate win could lead to gridlock and stalled judicial nominees.

item.title: Unlocking Houdini: How AI Is Shedding Light on His Life, Death, and Secrets
item.description:
“Houdini: Back from the Dead", now available on Fox Nation, is a first-of-its-kind, three-part documentary series that resurrects Houdini's story in the only way fitting: big, bold, impossible. On the 100th anniversary of his mysterious death – Halloween 2026 – Houdini comes back to life, revealing a side of him few know. For the first time, cutting-edge AI transforms photo archive of Houdini's most amazing stunts into video. We see him jump off bridges in chains and vanish from locked jails, safes, and underwater tanks.
FOX’s Krystin Goodwin speaks with George Hardeen, Podcast host and great-nephew of Harry Houdini, who shares intimate details of his relative the whole world admired.

item.title: Ballots in the Balance: The Explosive Legal Battles Over Election Security
item.description:
As legal battles intensify ahead of the midterms, federal efforts to challenge state voter rolls are sparking fierce debate over state sovereignty versus federal oversight. FOX News Sunday anchor Shannon Bream discusses the Democratic countersuit against the administration, why judges face urgent decisions on segregating disputed ballots, and how shifting poll numbers, along with foreign policy moves regarding Russia, are shaping the broader political landscape.
With control of the House at stake, Arizona’s 1st Congressional District is emerging as a key battleground. Former NFL kicker and Republican candidate Jay Feely joins FOX News White House correspondent Aishah Hasnie to discuss his tight race against Democrat Amish Shah, making his case to independent voters on affordability, housing costs, and data center development. Plus, Feely weighs in on the support he’s received from GOP leadership and why he believes Speaker Mike Johnson should continue leading House Republicans.
PLUS, commentary by Jason Chaffetz, FOX News contributor and the host of the Jason In The House podcast on FOX News Radio.  Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: Chef Robert Irvine: What Kills a Business—and How to Avoid It
item.description:
Celebrity chef and author Robert Irvine has a new book out 'Overcoming Impossible: Learn to Lead, Build a Team, and Catapult Your Business to Success' that shares his strategies for navigating economic hardship and supporting military families. In the book, Irvine outlines three main pillars for business success: empathetic leadership, eliminating personal ego, and trusting your team to stop micromanaging. The book combines lessons from his TV turnarounds with his own multi-company experience. He also highlights the challenges faced by active-duty military members and seniors dealing with food costs, tying back to his philanthropic work with the Robert Irvine Foundation.
FOX’s Gurnal Scott speaks with Chef Robert Irvine who says his new book can teach struggling businesses a new path while he puts food at center of effort to strengthen military families, and bring loved ones back to dinner table.

item.title: The Democrats' Midterm Promise: Investigations & Subpoenas
item.description:
Congressional Democrats are signaling an aggressive oversight agenda targeting the Trump administration, its allies, and incoming personnel if they regain the majority this midterm election cycle. While some Democratic lawmakers like Representative Robert Garcia and Senator Elissa Slotkin argue intense oversight is essential to check executive power, Republicans argue these warnings amount to political intimidation and "lawfare" aimed at deterring public service. FOX News congressional correspondent Bill Melugin speaks with FOX News contributor Ben Domenech to examine what a shifting balance of power on Capitol Hill would mean for day-to-day governance in Washington.
Amid shifting poll numbers and ongoing debate over Florida's rising cost of living, the battle for the governor's mansion reaches its final stretch. Republican nominee and Florida Congressman Byron Donalds joins to discuss his platform for lowering insurance rates and property taxes, addresses opponent David Jolly’s decision to decline debates, and explains why he believes his conservative vision continues to win over a diverse cross-section of Floridians.
PLUS, commentary by FOX News contributor Joe Concha.
